# Interval workout timer

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/interval-timer/

Alternate timed work and rest blocks for a chosen number of rounds. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Run eight rounds with 30 seconds of work followed by 15 seconds of rest.

## Limits and checks

This timer does not prescribe exercise intensity. Pausing preserves the remaining time; the final round has no extra rest block.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
